name: aplikasi-trading-journal-otomatis
description: Trading journal otomatis read-only untuk MEXC & Bitunix Futures (desktop lokal, single user)

scripts.verify:fase1: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs out/main/fase1-verify.js
scripts.verify:fase2: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs out/main/fase2-verify.js
scripts.verify:fase3: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs out/main/fase3-verify.js
scripts.verify:metrics: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs out/main/metrics-verify.js
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:fase1 && npm run verify:fase2 && npm run verify:fase3 && npm run verify:metrics
scripts.release: git add -A && git commit -m "chore: pre-release commit" --allow-empty && npm version patch -m "Bump version to %s" && git push && git push --tags && npm run dist
scripts.test:real-sync: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs out/main/test-real-sync.js
